synthesizedFacts.fact: Collagen Cross-Linked N-Telopeptide (NTx) is a marker used to evaluate bone resorption and skeletal health.
Elevated levels of NTx may indicate osteoporosis, metabolic bone disease, or increased bone turnover.
NTx tests can be used to monitor the efficacy of antiresorptive therapy in postmenopausal women.
Serum NTx levels are significantly higher in patients with solid tumors and bone metastases.
